summary: High severity security vulnerabilities found in temporalio/server v1.29.4 dependencies, including CVE-2026-24051 (HIGH) in go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk and CVE-2026-26958 (LOW) in filippo.io/edwards25519, requiring dependency updates.
userImpact: Users are exposed to security vulnerabilities in server dependencies that could compromise the security of their Temporal deployments.
rootCause: Outdated dependency versions with known vulnerabilities: filippo.io/edwards25519 1.1.0 (CVE-2026-26958) and go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk 1.34.0 (CVE-2026-24051)
proposedFix: Update filippo.io/edwards25519 from 1.1.0 to 1.1.1 and go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk from 1.34.0 to 1.40.0
